name: comp-291
blurb: Success card with title, description, action button, and dismiss.
description: Static success notification card with green checkmark icon, bold title, descriptive text, action button, and dismissible close. Larger vertical card layout.
use_when: You need to confirm a completed action with explanatory text and optional next steps.
avoid_when: For quick success messages or auto-dismissing notifications; use smaller banner alerts instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
